name: Tooltip
summary: Short explanation that shows on hover and keyboard focus. Never for essential or interactive content.
use: Short explanation of an abbreviation or icon.
avoid: Information the user needs to continue: put it on the page.
Links or buttons in the tooltip.
behaviour: Shows on hover and focus. Hides on leave, blur and Escape.
a11y: role="tooltip", linked to the trigger with aria-describedby.
Escape closes the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13).
do: Add a tooltip to every Button icon.
dont: A tooltip on disabled elements: they do not get focus.
open: The position does not adjust at the edge of the screen yet (no collision detection).
